source_snapshot.items: Fatal Error - VIN Bulk Input Only
source_snapshot.procedure: Uses the common programmable PMIC/I2C profile, lists valid UMCs, then provides a split socketdieumc0:0:3 railtype4 voltagetype0 dimm0 command; expects immediate reset and repeats for all DIMMs and voltage types0/1.
source_snapshot.criteria: Uncorrectable tool PASS and OS report within an undefined timeout with generic AMD RAS evidence.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic PMIC/power filtering cannot distinguish VIN bulk-input status from downstream switch rails or identify the physical DIMM.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; retains railtype4 and per-run safeguards but does not prove input-only semantics, comparator meanings, input-source telemetry or the fixed tuple's full population coverage.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Lacks VIN input-source evidence and exact PMIC status decoding.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Gates the fatal action but treats voltage types and electrical recovery generically.
historical_reviews.related_cases: SWD railtype3 tests a switch rail; Critical Temp uses railtype7. This row needs VIN bulk-input-only status and cannot pass on a generic PMIC reset.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Input-rail fault tests require source-specific voltage/status correlation and confirmation that downstream rails recover without persistent power-path fault.

original_test_intent: Inject the PMIC VIN bulk-input-only fatal condition for each required DIMM and voltage comparator, verify an immediate reset and fresh VIN-input evidence, then confirm the input supply, downstream rails and memory recover safely.
original_method: Map each DIMM/PMIC and its input supply; prove railtype4 and voltagetype encoding; identify BMC/platform I2C controller/address; record VIN and downstream-rail baseline; inject one tuple under OOB and electrical monitoring; correlate VIN-specific status and persistent logs; validate reset, training and memory; restore PMIC/I2C settings before another target.
manual_activity: The power/PMIC owner maps VIN and the target PMIC, approves each comparator tuple, monitors electrical behavior during one fatal injection and restores input/downstream rail and memory state.
required_inputs: PMIC documentation proving railtype4 is VIN Bulk Input Only and defining voltagetype0/1 comparators
Per-DIMM socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, PMIC part/address and VIN source topology
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB access and expected VIN status response
Vendor-correct command continuation and complete tuple matrix
VIN nominal range, downstream rail expectations, current/temperature limits and abort thresholds
Fresh VIN PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL evidence, reset/boot/training deadlines, memory recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated instrumented SUT with independent console and VIN/downstream rail telemetry
Verify physical input-source-to-PMIC mapping and preserve baseline status/SPD
Inject one comparator on one DIMM once with full restoration gate
Abort on wrong input status, unsafe VIN/downstream rail reading, unexpected reset, boot/training failure, DIMM loss or management-bus failure
No automatic target traversal; restore PMIC mode/recovery, SPD ownership, telemetry polling, I2C enables and HDT
agent_execution_scope: Validate VIN input-only semantics, target/I2C matrix, electrical envelope, evidence and recovery
Collect read-only VIN/downstream telemetry, PMIC status, OOB/CPER/BERT/SEL, DIMM training and memory health
Do not infer source/target, modify PMIC/I2C/BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, repeat, recover or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve electrical aborts and VIN-specific fatal oracle
Restore power/PMIC/memory state and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic PMIC and power-good logs cannot prove VIN bulk-input-only selection, comparator direction or recovery of downstream rails.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run one physically mapped railtype4 comparator with VIN and downstream telemetry, correlate VIN-specific persistent evidence and reset, then validate power and memory recovery before another target.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: listvalidumc, 0:0:3, railtype4, voltagetype0/1, dimm0, immediate reset, all-DIMM scope, PMIC/I2C settings and 360/120-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a serialized VIN-input fault matrix with input/downstream electrical correlation and complete DDR5 recovery per PMIC.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds VIN-source topology, input-only register proof, comparator definition, I2C address mapping, electrical limits and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A reset and generic PMIC log cannot show an input-only fault, and one dimm0 tuple cannot cover all targets.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect VIN injection can destabilize every downstream PMIC rail and prevent reliable reboot or DIMM recovery.

project_override_considerations: Use the project-required BMC/platform I2C path, not a host listing, to identify PMIC address/status. Ensure the monitoring method can distinguish VIN loss from a downstream SWA-SWD event.
expected_evidence: VIN/railtype4/voltagetype register map and physical input-to-PMIC/DIMM/I2C topology
Pinned tool/spec and raw VIN/downstream rail, status, SPD and BIOS baseline
Exact tuple plus OOB reset/firmware/boot timeline
Fresh VIN-input-only PMIC status and CPER/BERT/SEL source/severity
Restored input/downstream rails, DIMM training/enumeration and bounded memory health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All DIMMs and voltage types0/1 are required, but only fixed 0:0:3/dimm0/voltagetype0 is supplied; command continuation and expansion are undefined. Railtype4 and input-only/comparator semantics, I2C ownership and electrical criteria are unproven.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The VIN bulk-input fatal purpose is identifiable. Engineering can provide the mapping and safe electrical contract, allowing static review to complete.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 92 Wistron-System RAS-00812-V002: prove railtype4=VIN Bulk Input Only and define voltagetype0/1 comparator direction; map every DIMM/PMIC to VIN source, socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, PMIC address and Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/OOB path; approve command continuation/tuple matrix; define VIN/downstream electrical limits, PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL evidence, reset/boot/training deadlines, memory recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds input-source and downstream-rail discrimination so the VIN-only case cannot be satisfied by a generic PMIC fatal reset.
independent_technical_reasoning: VIN is upstream of the PMIC switch rails; a VIN fault can make downstream symptoms resemble SWA-SWD failures. The test therefore needs VIN-specific status plus simultaneous downstream telemetry to prove the selected domain. Repeating a hard-coded dimm0 tuple cannot cover physical PMICs, and each comparator direction requires separate electrical limits and full memory recovery.
